gui.hogwartsmagic.hogwarts_guide.header: A Field Guide for Young Witches and Wizards
spell.hogwartsmagic.expelliarmus.desc: Knocks items out of a target's hand and deals minor knockback.
spell.hogwartsmagic.glacius.desc: Freezes mobs in place and turns water into ice.
spell.hogwartsmagic.confringo.desc: Creates a fiery explosion at the target.
spell.hogwartsmagic.protego.desc: Creates a magical shield that reduces damage and reflects projectiles.
spell.hogwartsmagic.protego_maxima.desc: Aim upward and hold cast to sustain a skyward beam that slowly drains mana while forming a large protective bubble, or cast on a ward to raise its barrier.
spell.hogwartsmagic.lumos.desc: Toggles a magical light source that follows the caster.
spell.hogwartsmagic.accio.desc: Pulls objects and mobs towards the caster.
spell.hogwartsmagic.wingardium_leviosa.d: Causes the target to levitate into the air.
spell.hogwartsmagic.alohomora.desc: Unlocks doors, trapdoors, and fence gates.
spell.hogwartsmagic.incendio.desc: Sets blocks and mobs on fire.
spell.hogwartsmagic.stupefy.desc: Stuns mobs, making them blind and extremely slow.
spell.hogwartsmagic.revelio.desc: Reveals invisible mobs, highlights nearby ores through walls, and briefly breaks Cave Inimicum wards.
spell.hogwartsmagic.avada_kedavra.desc: The Killing Curse: Instantly kills the target. Costs some health to cast.
spell.hogwartsmagic.crucio.desc: Inflicts extreme pain, dealing damage over time and slowing the target.
spell.hogwartsmagic.sectumsempra.desc: Slashes the target with invisible blades, causing bleeding.
spell.hogwartsmagic.morsmordre.desc: Summons the Dark Mark and waves of hostile mobs.
spell.hogwartsmagic.dolohov_curse.desc: A purple flame curse that deals magic damage and prevents healing.
spell.hogwartsmagic.incarcerous.desc: Binds the target with chains from the ground: ankles, then legs together, then wrists.
spell.hogwartsmagic.heal.desc: A basic healing charm used to mend minor injuries.
spell.hogwartsmagic.tenebris_flight.desc: Death Eater Flight: Transform into black smoke for high-speed invulnerable flight.
gui.hogwartsmagic.spell_not_learned: You do not know this spell yet!
gui.hogwartsmagic.starter_magic_awarded: Your first wand hums to life and teaches you %s.
item.hogwartsmagic.hogwarts_invite.toolt: Right-click to unfold and read your letter.
item.hogwartsmagic.hogwarts_guide: Field Guide to the Wizarding Life
item.hogwartsmagic.hogwarts_guide.toolti: Right-click to open a handbook of spells, survival, magical tools, and curious dangers.
item.hogwartsmagic.hogwarts_invite.openi: The wax seal breaks and the parchment unfolds...
item.hogwartsmagic.hogwarts_invite.line2: You are invited to begin your studies at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.
item.hogwartsmagic.hogwarts_invite.line3: Seek out a wand, study your spellbooks, and present yourself to the Sorting Hat when the time comes.
item.hogwartsmagic.hogwarts_invite.line4: May your courage, curiosity, and magic guide you through the halls ahead.
message.hogwartsmagic.invite_arrived: An owl circles above and drops a Hogwarts invitation addressed to %s.
message.hogwartsmagic.invite_and_guide_a: An owl circles above and drops a Hogwarts invitation and a well-worn field guide addressed to %s.
spell.hogwartsmagic.expecto_patronum.des: Summons a majestic glowing Patronus to repel evil Dementors and light up the darkness.
spell.hogwartsmagic.bombarda.desc: Creates a powerful explosion at the target's location without destroying blocks.
spell.hogwartsmagic.depulso.desc: Banishes the target backwards with massive force.
spell.hogwartsmagic.levicorpus.desc: Dangles the target helplessly in the air by their ankles.
spell.hogwartsmagic.diffindo.desc: Severs the target, dealing high physical damage.
spell.hogwartsmagic.petrificus_totalus.d: Performs a full body-bind, paralyzing the target completely.
spell.hogwartsmagic.aqua_eructo.desc: Shoots a blast of water that extinguishes fires and heavily damages fiery creatures.
spell.hogwartsmagic.obliviate.desc: Wipes the target's memory, confusing them and making them forget who they were fighting.
spell.hogwartsmagic.ascendio.desc: Violently launches the caster or target high into the air.
spell.hogwartsmagic.confundo.desc: Greatly confuses the target, causing them to attack anything nearby.
spell.hogwartsmagic.cave_inimicum.desc: Anchors a protected illusion to a ward block. Outside viewers see the frozen snapshot; inside viewers see reality.
spell.hogwartsmagic.alatus.desc: Channels flight magic into a Broom Workbench that already holds a valid recipe, beginning the infusion.
spell.hogwartsmagic.serpensortia.desc: Summons several allied, venomous spiders to attack your enemies.
spell.hogwartsmagic.arresto_momentum.des: Softens a fall and bleeds away momentum. Self-cast to survive a plunge or strike a target to slow its descent.
spell.hogwartsmagic.reparo.desc: Rebuilds nearby recently-broken simple blocks if you can pay with matching block items from your inventory.
spell.hogwartsmagic.apparition.desc: Channel for four seconds and pick a known spot on a nearby map, then Disapparate with a crack and reappear there. Anyone within a block comes with you. Botch the focus — long range, or a hit while channeling — and you risk being Splinched. Cannot be cast inside an anti-Apparition ward.
gui.hogwartsmagic.apparition.title: Apparition — Choose Your Destination
gui.hogwartsmagic.apparition.hint: Click a place you know. Hold still — focus is everything.
message.hogwartsmagic.apparition.blocked: You cannot picture that destination clearly.
item.hogwartsmagic.sorting_hat.tooltip: Wear it to begin your Hogwarts house interview.
item.hogwartsmagic.magical_silk.tooltip: A shimmering repair thread used to mend an Invisibility Cloak on an anvil.
item.hogwartsmagic.invisibility_cloak.to: Right-click to vanish for a short time.
Attacking or taking damage briefly reveals you.
message.hogwartsmagic.invisibility_cloak: The cloak's magic has not recovered yet.
Wand Blank + Phoenix Feather Core + Arcane Core = Phoenix Core Wand
Wand Blank + Unicorn Hair Core + Arcane Core = Unicorn Core Wand
Wand Blank + Dragon Heartstring Core + Arcane Core = Dragon Core Wand
gui.hogwartsmagic.broom_workbench.recipe: Place ingredients on the table; they stay when you close the GUI. Cast Alatus on the bench to infuse (Basic: Stick, Wheat, Arcane Dust, Iron → Broom).
Nimbus: Broom + Phantom Membrane + Netherite Ingot + Arcane Core. Firebolt: Nimbus + Netherite Ingot + Elytra + Dragon Heartstring Core.
Nothing crafts until Alatus hits the workbench block while the recipe is complete and the result slot is empty.
chat.hogwartsmagic.sorting_hat.greeting: Ahh... a new student. Let's see where you belong.
chat.hogwartsmagic.sorting_hat.wait: Patience, I'm still thinking about your last answer.
chat.hogwartsmagic.sorting_hat.empty: Speak up now, I need a real answer.
